outcome_evidence: In base_image, the robot separates the initially nested cups (frames 140–227), arranges two cups below a third, and releases a stable three-cup pyramid (frames 361–390). It then lifts the upper cup and nests the cups together sequentially (frames 470–630 and 651–705). Both grippers withdraw, leaving a compact nested stack standing on the table through frame 764 (frames 716–764). This supports stacking and packing by nesting; no separate packaging container is visible, and no failed acquisition, toppling, or unintended side effect is observed.
